fixes.fix: last()/nth_or_last() no longer swallow TypeError/IndexError raised while iterating (treated as empty iterable)
fixes.why: Errors raised by a generator mid-iteration (e.g. map(int, [...None])) were silently turned into the default value, hiding real failures.
fixes.upstream_commit: 319b243 Reversed is more general than seq[-1]

fixes.fix: bucket lookups (`in`, s[key]) no longer register phantom keys that then appear when iterating
fixes.why: Asking for a missing key made it appear in list(bucket), a wrong result.
fixes.upstream_commit: 2b8d5cd Issue 1284: don't let a bucket lookup invent a key (+288d6da)

fixes.fix: interleave_evenly([]) returns empty instead of crashing
fixes.why: Raised IndexError on an empty list of iterables.
fixes.upstream_commit: f51a53b fix: handle empty interleave_evenly input

fixes.fix: sort_together with empty iterables returns one empty tuple per input
fixes.why: Returned [] so `a, b = sort_together([a, b])` crashed on empty input, violating the one-tuple-per-iterable contract.

fixes.fix: divide() accepts mappings (slice lookup raises KeyError on 3.12+)
fixes.why: divide(n, dict) crashed with KeyError because slices are hashable in 3.12+.

fixes.fix: numeric_range __len__ adjusted so len() matches iteration/indexing for floats
fixes.why: len() disagreed with the number of produced items for float ranges.
fixes.upstream_commit: dc2664b Issue 1247: Keep numeric_range consistent with the items it produces

fixes.fix: numeric_range __reversed__ yields the exact same values as forward iteration
fixes.why: Reversed float ranges produced different values/lengths than forward iteration.
fixes.upstream_commit: 752799b Preserve numeric_range values during reverse iteration (+feaddee)

fixes.fix: time_limited stops pulling from the source once timed out
fixes.why: Each next() after timeout consumed and discarded an item from the underlying iterator (data loss).

fixes.fix: weighted sample with population smaller than k returns the whole population
fixes.why: sample([], 3, weights=[]) crashed with IndexError while the unweighted path returns [].

fixes.fix: value_chain propagates TypeError raised during iteration instead of yielding the iterable as a scalar
fixes.why: A TypeError mid-iteration was masked and the object yielded as a value after partial output.
fixes.upstream_commit: 7847d43 Don't mask TypeError raised while iterating in value_chain

fixes.fix: combination_with_replacement_index handles None elements in the pool
fixes.why: None was used as an exhaustion sentinel so pools containing None gave wrong indexes/errors.

fixes.fix: outer_product with empty ys yields an empty tuple per x instead of crashing
fixes.why: Raised ValueError (batched n=0) for an empty ys.

fixes.fix: windowed running_mean recomputes the sum when an inf/NaN leaves the window
fixes.why: One inf in the stream made every later windowed mean NaN forever (inf - inf).

fixes.fix: running_mean/min/max validate maxlen via the index protocol (reject floats)
fixes.why: Non-integer maxlen was silently accepted and produced wrong windows.
fixes.upstream_commit: 670b715 Validate running window sizes through the index protocol
